pc_changelog:
v8.2.0 – Smart Memory Optimization & Instant Thumbnails

• New: Top 5 image thumbnails are permanently cached in RAM for instant, zero-flash summon appearance.
• Improved: Background memory footprint reduced to under 50 MB via Win32 working set trimming.
• Improved: Startup image decoding capped to top 5 images for faster cold launch.
• Improved: Off-screen image eviction refined from 10 to 5 images for tighter memory control.
• Fixed: Cloudflare tunnel auto-reactivation race condition when toggling outgoing sync.
